responsibility: This file implements the parser that reconstructs a full GCC RTL function, including CFG, from the structured dumps emitted by print-rtl-function.c. Its function_reader subclass of rtx_reader recognizes function-, param-, block-, edge-, insn-chain-, and crtl-level directives, creates the function and basic blocks, defers and fixes up cross-references such as insn UIDs, block IDs, source locations, and MEM exprs, and then finalizes the insn chain and edges. It also contains extensive selftests for loading RTL fragments and full CFGs. Its responsibility is whole-function RTL dump deserialization rather than generic RTX syntax parsing.
same_name_distinction: Implements the read-rtl-function interface: the concrete RTL function dump reader that rebuilds functions, basic blocks, edges, and deferred references, and also houses related selftests; the header only declares entry points for invoking this loader.
